name: theme-provider
title: Theme Provider
description: Three-state theme state (system, light, dark) with a matching inline script for the first paint.
docs: Wrap the app in ThemeProvider and read state with useTheme(): theme is the stored choice, resolvedTheme is what is painted. setTheme writes localStorage only when the choice changes, and system removes the key when defaultTheme is system so the OS preference keeps driving the page. Inline the themeScript() string in head before your bundle to avoid a flash on reload; it only touches the html element, so hydration has nothing to disagree with.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, provide, ref, watch } from 'vue'
import {
  DEFAULT_STORAGE_KEY,
  applyThemeToDocument,
  readStoredTheme,
  systemTheme,
  type ResolvedTheme,
  type ThemeChoice,
} from './theme'
import { themeKey, type ThemeApi } from './context'

export type ThemeProviderProps = {
  storageKey?: string
  /** Used when nothing is stored yet. */
  defaultTheme?: ThemeChoice
  /** Attribute mirrored onto `html` so CSS can target the explicit choice. */
  attribute?: string
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<ThemeProviderProps>(), {
  storageKey: DEFAULT_STORAGE_KEY,
  defaultTheme: 'system',
  attribute: 'data-theme',
})

const theme = ref<ThemeChoice>(props.defaultTheme)
const resolvedTheme = ref<ResolvedTheme>(props.defaultTheme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light')
const hydrated = ref(false)

let media: MediaQueryList | undefined

function sync(): void {
  resolvedTheme.value = applyThemeToDocument(theme.value, props.attribute)
}

function setTheme(next: ThemeChoice): void {
  theme.value = next
}

// localStorage is written only when the choice changes, not on every system
// preference event: those are not user decisions and must not pin `system`.
watch(theme, (next) => {
  sync()
  if (!hydrated.value) return
  try {
    if (next === 'system' && props.defaultTheme === 'system') {
      localStorage.removeItem(props.storageKey)
    } else {
      localStorage.setItem(props.storageKey, next)
    }
  } catch {
    // A blocked storage backend still needs the in-memory choice to apply.
  }
})

function onSystemChange(): void {
  // Only matters while following the system; a pinned choice ignores it.
  if (theme.value === 'system') sync()
}

onMounted(() => {
  theme.value = readStoredTheme(props.storageKey, props.defaultTheme)
  sync()
  hydrated.value = true
  media = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)')
  media.addEventListener('change', onSystemChange)
})

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  media?.removeEventListener('change', onSystemChange)
})

const api: ThemeApi = {
  theme,
  resolvedTheme,
  setTheme,
  systemTheme,
  get storageKey() {
    return props.storageKey
  },
}
provide(themeKey, api)

const ready = computed(() => hydrated.value)
defineExpose({ ready, theme, resolvedTheme, setTheme })
</script>

<template>
  <slot />
</template>

export { default as ThemeProvider } from './ThemeProvider.vue'
export { useTheme, DEFAULT_STORAGE_KEY } from './context'
export { applyThemeToDocument, readStoredTheme, systemTheme, themeScript } from './theme'
export type { ThemeApi } from './context'
export type { ThemeProviderProps } from './ThemeProvider.vue'
export type { ResolvedTheme, ThemeChoice } from './theme'
